symptom_1_secret_exposure.observation: Debug echo statements printing raw secret variables to standard output in CI runner
symptom_1_secret_exposure.root_cause: A developer inserted an echo command (e.g., echo $SECRET) to troubleshoot auth failures. Even if masked in some runners, base64 or sub-string formatting can expose credentials in plaintext build logs.
symptom_1_secret_exposure.remediation: Remove all echo statements of credentials. Use automated authentication actions (e.g. docker/login-action) that securely inject credentials into the Docker config without stdout exposure.

symptom_2_pipeline_slowdown.observation: Pipeline runtime quadrupled despite no code changes
symptom_2_pipeline_slowdown.root_cause: Misconfigured cache-dependency-path or invalidated cache key (e.g. hashing a wildcard directory that changes every commit or pointing to a nonexistent lockfile path), resulting in 100% cache misses and full package re-downloads.
symptom_2_pipeline_slowdown.remediation: Pin cache keys strictly to the lockfile checksum (${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}) so cache hits occur reliably across all commits unless dependencies actually change.

symptom_3_unintended_deployments.observation: Feature branches pushing images to container registry
symptom_3_unintended_deployments.root_cause: Missing branch conditional on registry push steps. Without 'if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'', any branch push executes the push steps.
symptom_3_unintended_deployments.remediation: Enforce explicit branch gating ('if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'') ensuring only verified commits on main trigger container registry publish.
